en-US.author: Ludo Technologies
en-US.description: Always-on presence app for remote teams
en-US.longDescription: Hiroba is an open-source, always-on presence app for remote teams. See who is around on a shared 2D floor, walk over for spatial voice, or page a teammate directly. Voice is WebRTC peer-to-peer, so audio never passes through the server. Use the hosted edition or self-host the Rust server.
en-US.name: Hiroba
en-US.releaseNotes:
Desktop installers for Hiroba v0.3.4.
After installing, open an invite link or point the app at your server.
Server self-hosting: docs/SELF_HOSTING.md
Full Changelog: v0.3.3...v0.3.4
